headline: Patriots rule out A.J. Brown, TreVeyon Henderson vs. Dolphins
summary: Patriots wide receiver A.J. Brown has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Dolphins. In addition, No. 2 running back TreVeyon Henderson has been ruled out due to an illness.

headline: Roster Analysis: Patriots downgrade WR A.J. Brown, RB TreVeyon Henderson to out for Week 8 vs. Dolphins
summary: With Brown (ankle/knee) and Henderson (illness) out, the Patriots signed RB Lan Larison to the active roster and elevated WR Ryan Miller from the practice squad for Week 8.

headline: Patriots Sign RB Lan Larison to 53-Man Roster from the Practice Squad; Elevate WR Ryan Miller from Practice Squad to Active Roster
summary: The Patriots announced today that RB Lan Larison has been signed to the 53-man roster from the practice squad. In addition, WR Ryan Miller has been elevated to the active roster from the practice squad.
